requirements.name: RF measurement experience

lines.quote: Responsible for RF emissions compliance testing of Hohtola's optical sensor electronics: conducted radiated-emissions measurements with a calibrated EMI receiver and log-periodic antenna in a semi-anechoic chamber, and pre-compliance characterisation using a Rigol DSA815 spectrum analyser.

What I do bring from the RF side is hands-on measurement experience: I have been responsible for the radiated-emissions compliance testing of every Hohtola product since 2012, which means regular time on the RF test bench with spectrum analysers and EMI receivers.

requirements.note: This is EMC/radiated-emissions compliance testing rather than RF front-end calibration; the candidate herself describes it as 'RF test bench work rather than RF design'. evidence_found reflects the concrete named equipment and chamber work described, with the domain match to the requirement's own framing left to the recruiter's judgement.

lines.quote: I hold dual Italian-Dutch nationality and am an EU citizen with no work-permit restrictions.
All technical documentation, customer specifications, and internal design reviews conducted in English.
Relocated from Helsinki to Oulu in 2017 with the Hohtola office move and have been based here since.
I have been in Oulu since 2017 when Hohtola relocated the division here, and I have no intention of leaving.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any production embedded signal-processing software you have written in C or C++, if any?
Can you describe any Python code you have written to production or engineering standards, if any?
